question: what a rename does, for the rename the card posts

addresses.name: CRenameSubUnitCommand::Execute
addresses.comment: Slot 6: resolves the sub-unit by its id pair (+0x40/+0x44); UnregisterUnitName(its country, its name); the name (+0x68) set from the command's (+0x64); RegisterUnitName(its country, the name). It tests nothing. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-sunkships.md, section 3.3.
addresses.evidence: Read whole on the listing; the vftable 0x15C8E9C is the one its constructor writes.

addresses.name: UnregisterUnitName
addresses.comment: The inverse of RegisterUnitName: while the name is in the country's set of names in use (+0x84), takes it off and frees it, so that the name can be used again. `ret 4`.
addresses.evidence: Read on the listing: the find on +0x84, a removal, a free of the string, and the find again.
